verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a programmatic API (developer/api.md, a changelog entry adding GET /task-statuses), but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. An existing API does not by itself deliver an interactive, runnable reference, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
